blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Mrs Klein is over 80, but she's still very active.
exercises.ru: Госпоже Кляйн за восемьдесят, ___ она всё еще очень активна.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: They may be poor, but rich in spirit.
exercises.ru: Они могут жить бедно, ___ быть богатыми душой.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The X-axis is the horizontal axis and the Y-axis is the vertical axis.
exercises.ru: Ось X — горизонтальная, ___ ось Y — вертикальная.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: One of my grandmothers is Jewish, and the other's an antisemite.
exercises.ru: У меня одна бабушка еврейка, ___ вторая - антисемитка.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Are you the author of this book?
exercises.ru: ___ ты автор этой книги?
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Herbert opened his mouth, but Tom gave him a menacing look.
exercises.ru: Герберт открыл было рот, ___ Том грозно на него глянул.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom is a centaur and Mary is a nymph.
exercises.ru: Том - кентавр, ___ Мэри - нимфа.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Protons have a positive charge, electrons have a negative charge, and neutrons have no charge.
exercises.ru: Протоны имеют положительный заряд, электроны - отрицательный, ___ нейтроны не имеют заряда.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I used to think like you, but then I got better.
exercises.ru: Когда-то я думал, как ты, ___ потом исправился.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You're asleep; I'm awake.
exercises.ru: Ты спишь, ___ я бодрствую.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Math is like love: a simple idea, but it can get complicated.
exercises.ru: Математика — она как любовь: идея-то проста, ___ могут возникнуть сложности.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Christ was betrayed by Judas on Wednesday, and crucified on Friday.
exercises.ru: Христос был предан Иудой в среду, ___ распят в пятницу.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I tried it, but it's super complicated.
exercises.ru: Я попробовал, ___ это мегасложно.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Peanuts are not nuts but legumes.
exercises.ru: Арахис - это не орехи, ___ бобовые.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The sound was annoying but harmless to the human body.
exercises.ru: Звук был раздражающим, ___ безопасным для человеческого тела.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Iga is a shortening of Jadwiga, but used as a name in its own right.
exercises.ru: Ига – сокращение от Ядвиги, ___ используется как самостоятельное имя.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: We don't have a coffee machine at the office but we want one.
exercises.ru: У нас в офисе нет кофеварки, ___ мы хотим её приобрести.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He is buried but not broken.
exercises.ru: Похоронен, ___ не сломлен.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The boy adored his father, but he was a little afraid of his mother.
exercises.ru: Отца мальчик обожал, ___ мать побаивался.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's wrath is heavier than them both.
exercises.ru: Тяжёл камень, увесист и песок; ___ гнев глупца тяжелее их обоих.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
